patterns_found.name: Double Top
patterns_found.evidence: Two distinct swing highs visible near the 0.0000040-0.0000041 area with an intervening trough around 0.00000395. Price is currently below the peaks and drifting lower toward the neckline area.

vlm_analysis.visual_evidence: Price advanced from ~0.0000037 to resistance near 0.00000405, formed dual peaks, and is now pulling back. Volume appears lighter on the recent highs compared to the initial rally.
limitations: Latest candle may still be forming
Pattern not confirmed until neckline breaks
Cryptocurrency markets can invalidate technical patterns quickly due to news or volume spikes
